variants.headline: Party divides in two
variants.body: The party {party} has split, with {splinter} the new breakaway party. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: A political organisation breaks apart
variants.body: A split in {party} has produced the new party {splinter}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Unity gives way to a party split
variants.body: The new party {splinter} has broken away from {party}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
